takeaway: An end-effector delta is only numbers until its frame is named: a move recorded in the tool's frame and replayed in the table's frame lands somewhere else once the tool is turned, and agrees only when the tool is square.
sentence: A movement recorded relative to the tool goes in the wrong direction if it is replayed relative to the table after the tool turns.
reason: Both say that replaying a tool-relative move in table-relative directions produces a different result after the tool turns.
